originalSourceText:
7. What is the primary purpose of the Waypoint Tracking phase in
   the GNSS navigation pipeline?

   A) To calculate the satellite dilution of precision (PDOP).

   B) To close the control loop by continuously comparing live
  GNSS positions against current target waypoints.

   C) To convert Latitude and Longitude to ECEF coordinates.

   D) To precompute road network edge weights.

   Answer: B
   Refer to Lecture 39: GPS Path Finding Slide 30
